rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality day-5 blastocyst with appropriate caution about limits of a single static image; aligns reasonably with reported 4AA, though it is somewhat noncommittal about visible hatching/herniation and ICM identification.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, prior failed cycles, BMI, semen quality, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimate appropriately tempered by prior failures; minor issue is tension between accepting the DOR label and emphasizing reassuring AMH/FSH without fully resolving it.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with Gardner grading, single embryo transfer principles, uterine reassessment after failures, and caution against unproven add-ons; slight overreach in discussing euploid implantation benchmarks without case-specific testing context.
Provides practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, uterine cavity reassessment, embryology review, and selective PGT-A discussion.
